verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Signifyd's test-team mechanism, where test orders are "not used in model learning". That is a test-isolation feature, converted only through Signifyd support, and not a privacy control that keeps a customer's real data out of model training. Because it is an adjacent control, it earns no credit, and the pack documents no opt-out from model training for production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
